content: Seera dosiya uray eratethi dosees; shin seera ixiya uray eeya.
Lo77o asi Godaape saba demmees; shin Goday genanchota pirdees.
Asi iitatethan minnidi eqenna;
Wozanaama machiya ba azinaas kallacha mela; shin ba azina kawushiya machiya meqethi miya ajaaje mela.
Xilluwa qofay suure; shin iitata zorey cimo.
Iitata zoretay asa qohanaasa; shin xillota zoretay enta ashshanaasa.
Iita asati kundana; entaw zerethika attenna; shin xillota kochay minnidi de7ana.
Asi ba cincatetha mela galatetees; shin geella qofay de7iya asi kadhetees.
Dure asi daanidi, meton de7iya asaape coo asa daanidi, oothiiddi ba de7o sugiya asi keeha.
Xillo asi ba mehes qadhetees, shin wozana mino asas qadhey baawa.
Ba biitta minthi oothiya uray kathi kallees; shin pathonnaba yedethiya uray akeeki pacidaysa.
Iitati nagarancho asata di77anaw amottoosona; shin xillota xaphoy daayidi de7ana.
Iita asa iya doonape keyida odi xihe gididi oykees; shin xilloy metope kessi ekees.
Asi ba doonape keyiya qaalan lo77oba kallees; ba oothida ooso gatiya ekees.
Eeya asi biya buussay aw iya huuphen like daanees; shin cinca asi zore si7ees.
Eeya uraa hanqoy ellesidi eretees; shin cinca asi cashshe wuda geenna.
Tumaa haasayiya asi suureba odees; shin wordo markay wordo odees.
Akeekona odetiya odi mashshada caddees;
Wordo odi guutha wodesa; shin tuma odi merinaw de7ana.
Iita qopiya asaa wozanan cimoy de7ees;

content.text: shin saroba zoreteyisata wozanan ufaysay kumees.

content: Xillota metoy gakenna; shin iitatas metoy darana.
Goday wordanchota ixees; shin tumancho asatan I ufaytees.
Cinca asi ba eraa qottees; shin eeyati banta eeyatetha odoosona.
Minnidi oothiya uray dere haarees; shin azalla asi haaretees.
Un7an kumida wozani azzano ehees; shin keeha odi iya ufaysees.
Xillo asi ba shooruwa zoridi, suure oge kaalethees; shin iitati oge tumaape haassees.
Azalla asi shankatidi ehida asho kathenna;

content.text: shin minnidi oothiya uray ba miishiyas mishetees.

content: Xillotethaa ogen de7oy de7ees; he ogen hayqoy baawa.
